places.name: Missouri River
places.note: Herd crosses it in bitter cold; Jasper is thrown in and rescued. Later Newt's horse breaks through its shallow ice near the fort.

places.name: Fort Benton
places.note: Small Army post where Major Court buys beef; Call returns to sell more, and Newt stays a month breaking the Army's horses.
places.location_hint: on the Missouri River in Montana Territory

places.name: Rocky Mountains
places.note: Their long line stays visible to the west as Call keeps pushing northwest; snow covers the slopes by the Milk.
places.location_hint: west of the herd's route north of the Missouri

places.name: Marias River
places.note: The day after crossing it, Old Dog is found eaten by grizzlies and the herd stampedes.
places.location_hint: between the Missouri and the Milk in Montana

places.name: Milk River
places.note: The outfit's final river; Call ends the drive here and has the herd pushed east along its valley to winter.

places.name: Hat Creek ranch (Montana)
places.note: Log house built on a timbered creek after blizzards; Call sleeps in a tent outside, and Dish quits and rides south from here.
places.location_hint: on a timbered creek between the Milk and Missouri rivers, about a day's drive east of where they first struck the Milk; northern Montana near Canada; roughly fifteen miles from a box canyon

places.name: Wild horse box canyon
places.note: Wild horse herd is trapped here; Bert ropes eighteen for the remuda.
places.location_hint: about fifteen miles south of the Montana ranch headquarters, between the Milk and Missouri

places.name: Fort Buford
places.note: Another Army post the outfit drives beef to during the winter.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Old Hugh says it begins not far north of the Milk.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call finds its northern reaches nearly empty but for buffalo and Indians; the men must winter there.

places.name: Chicago
places.note: In Call's dream, Gus teases him to turn east and ride on till he reaches it.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Too late for most to return there this fall; Dish asks about going back.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Major Court is astonished the cattle were gathered south of its border.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Dish means to hurry there to Lorena; Soupy doubts he'll survive the trip.

places.name: Miles City
places.note: Call has credit at its small bank and writes Dish an order on it for his wages.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Soupy predicts Dish won't even get that far.

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: Dish tells the men to look for him south of it if they ever get home.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: wintering at the new log headquarters between the Milk and Missouri

groups.label: Newt
groups.hint: left at the fort for a month breaking Army horses

groups.label: Dish Boggett
groups.hint: riding south alone from the Montana ranch toward Nebraska

groups.label: Old Hugh Auld
groups.hint: comes and goes from the ranch on his pony
